fullPassage: Alan Seeger, an American poet, was born in New York City in 1888 and grew up in a wealthy home. After his father's trading business went bankrupt, his family moved to Mexico City for two years. Its landscape influenced many of his works. Seeger returned to the States and later graduated from Harvard University, where he was inspired by the Romantic poets. Seeger left for Paris, France to live out his romanticized notion of bohemian life and made friendships with many artists. When World War I broke out in 1914, he joined the French army as a volunteer to defend his beloved France. During the war, he wrote a poem, I Have a Rendezvous with Death, about a soldier accepting his upcoming death and it made Seeger instantly famous when it was published. Seeger died during the Battle of the Somme in 1916. Following his death, the French Military awarded him the Croix de Guerre, the highest French military honor.

questions.passage: Seeger left for Paris, France to live out his romanticized notion of bohemian life and made __________ with many artists. (friend)

det.analysis: made __________(friend) with many artists — 동사 made 뒤에 명사 필요. 'make friendships with'는 '~와 우정을 쌓다'라는 의미. friend → friendships(명사 복수형)로 변환.
det.tip: made friendships with many artists — '많은 예술가들과 우정을 쌓았다'. friend → friendship(명사) → friendships(복수).

questions.passage: Seeger returned to the States and later graduated from Harvard University, where he was inspired by the __________ poets. (romance)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: the __________(romance) poets — 명사 poets를 수식하는 형용사 필요. romance(명사)를 형용사형 Romantic으로 변환. 문학사조로서의 Romantic poets(낭만주의 시인들).
det.tip: the Romantic poets — '낭만주의 시인들'. romance → Romantic은 명사 → 형용사 변환.

questions.passage: Alan Seeger, an American poet, was born in New York City in 1888 and grew up in a wealthy home. After his father's trading business went bankrupt, his family moved to Mexico City for two years. Its landscape influenced many of his works. Seeger returned to the States and later graduated from Harvard University, where he was inspired by the Romantic poets. Seeger left for Paris, France to live out his romanticized notion of bohemian life and made friendships with many artists. When World War I broke out in 1914, he joined the French army as a volunteer to defend his beloved France. During the war, he wrote a poem, I Have a Rendezvous with Death, about a soldier accepting his upcoming death and it made Seeger instantly famous when it was published. Seeger died during __________. Following his death, the French Military awarded him the Croix de Guerre, the highest French military honor.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① the Battle of the Somme in 1916: 1916년 솜 전투 — 원문과 일치 ←정답
② World War I in 1914: 1차 세계대전은 1914년에 발발했지만 시거 사망 시기 아님
③ the French Revolution in 1789: 프랑스 혁명은 시대가 다름
④ the Battle of Paris in 1918: 파리 전투는 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: Seeger died during the Battle of the Somme in 1916 — 솜 전투에서 1916년에 전사.
